metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: SQL Server — SUSPENDED Login State Anomaly
properties.description: Detects SQL Server logins in SUSPENDED state indicating potential credential abuse
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "sql" or action_name_s contains "server" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 5 // AZ-DB-MSS-002
